full_prompt_en: The image is a square symbolist painted portrait of a young girl looking straight ahead, surrounded by deep charcoal hair and subdued gold. The background is almost black, with a fine, worn brown-green grain that is visible mainly around the upper corners and outer silhouette. Near the top edge, an incomplete gold arc curves behind the head, its irregular ornament resembling aged decorative leaf rather than a luminous halo. The girl's dark hair parts at the centre and expands into long, dense curls on both sides, forming a rounded, nearly symmetrical frame around her face. Fine brown strands emerge at the hairline, but most of the mass remains deeply shadowed, merging with the surrounding field. In the upper centre, her pale forehead forms a broad soft shape beneath the narrow parting. Dark eyebrows descend slightly toward the bridge of the nose, giving the gaze a concentrated and solemn quality. Her grey-green eyes meet the viewer, with restrained highlights and subtle warm shadow beneath the lower lids. The nose is straight and softly modelled, its light ridge balanced by narrow brown-grey shade along the sides. At the centre of the lower face, the small closed mouth carries a muted reddish-brown tone, neither smiling nor visibly distressed. Pale cheeks taper toward a rounded chin, and a faint shadow beneath the jaw separates the head from the short visible neck. Along the left edge of the face, the dark hair presses close to the cheek, while the right side opens just enough to reveal a delicate transition from skin into shadow. The shoulders occupy the lower corners in a plain, nearly black garment whose boundary is difficult to distinguish from the background. A shallow curved neckline sits below the neck, with the cloth contributing a quiet horizontal base to the otherwise vertical facial arrangement. The crop is close enough that no hands or surrounding objects enter the image. Across the painted surface, small speckles and rubbed transitions soften the portrait's precision, especially within the darker passages. Gentle frontal light, slightly stronger from above and to the left, illuminates the forehead, nose and cheeks without introducing a visible cast shadow or a bright rim. The face seems to emerge from the surrounding darkness through tonal contrast rather than through a separate physical setting. The overall composition is compact and almost symmetrical, its pale central face, enveloping black-brown field and restrained gold accent creating a poised, psychologically intense stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形象征主义绘画肖像，年轻女孩正视前方，周围是深炭黑头发与低调金色。背景几乎全黑，只在上角和外轮廓附近显出磨旧的棕绿细颗粒。上缘一道不完整金弧绕到头后，不规则纹饰近似古旧金箔，而非发光光环。深色头发中央分开，长而密集的卷发向两侧扩展，形成圆润、近对称的脸部框架。发际线露出细棕发丝，其余发团大多沉入暗色，并与背景相融。上方中央，浅额头在窄发缝下形成宽而柔软的形。深眉向鼻根略压低，使眼神专注肃静。灰绿色双眼直视观者，亮点克制，下眼睑有细微暖影。笔直鼻梁被柔和明暗塑造，浅色中脊两边是狭窄棕灰暗面。脸下部中央的小嘴闭合，呈暗红棕色，没有微笑，也没有明显痛苦。浅脸颊收向圆下巴，下颌淡影使头与短短露出的脖子分开。脸左缘的深发贴近面颊，右侧则略微露出皮肤过渡到阴影的柔边。双肩占据下方两角，衣服近黑且简洁，轮廓难与背景区分。浅弧形领口位于颈下，为竖向脸部安排提供安静的横向底座。紧密裁切使画中没有双手或周围道具。细碎颗粒和擦柔过渡遍布表面，尤其暗部，使精准面孔保持绘画感。柔和正面光略偏上方和左侧，照亮额头、鼻及双颊，没有显眼投影或强轮廓亮边。面孔依靠色调反差从黑暗中浮现，而非依赖具体场景。整体紧凑且近对称，浅色中央面孔、包裹它的黑棕色场和克制金饰，共同形成端正而心理张力强烈的静止感。
style_prompt_en: The painted language isolates a softly modelled light form inside a nearly black field, using close cropping and near-symmetry to concentrate attention. Muted ivory and grey-green are warmed by restrained reddish-brown accents, while aged gold appears sparingly at the periphery. Edges alternate between precise focal contours and dark passages that dissolve into their surroundings. Fine grain and rubbed transitions give the surface a worn, matte density. Soft frontal illumination produces inward-looking intensity rather than theatrical spectacle. The overall effect is solemn and concentrated, with decorative restraint and a narrow tonal hierarchy carrying most of the expressive weight.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画语言把柔和塑造的浅色形体孤立在近黑色场中，紧密裁切与近对称结构集中注意力。暗象牙白、灰绿由克制红棕点缀调暖，古金只在边缘少量出现。焦点轮廓精确，暗部边缘则融入环境。细颗粒和擦柔过渡让表面具有磨旧、哑光的厚度。柔和正面光产生内省张力而非舞台式效果。整体肃静集中，装饰克制、明暗层级狭窄，却承担主要情绪。
theme_en: A solemn frontal portrait framed by dark hair and a muted gold arc
theme_zh: 深发与暗金弧形围绕的肃静正面肖像
name: Franz von Stuck
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
